metadata.name: Commercial International Bank (Egypt) S.A.E.
metadata.benchmark_bond: CIB Egypt (IFC Tier 2 / Sovereign-Capped Egyptian Private Bank Leader)
metadata.provenance: financials built 23-Nov-26 from CIB Egypt FY2025 & 9M 2026 EGX/LSE financial filings (Nov-26); quotes await [BBG] capture

financials_multi_year.source: CIB Egypt FY2025 Audited Financial Statements (EGX / LSE RNS), read 23-Nov-26

observations.notes: FY25 assets EGP 1.44tn (vs 1.21tn FY24), gross loans EGP 576bn (+44% YoY), deposits EGP 1.11tn (+14% YoY), revenue EGP 117bn (+19% YoY), NPAT EGP 82.25bn (+49% YoY), NPL 1.67% (358% coverage), Total CAR 27.3%.

9M26 revenue EGP 103bn (NII +19% YoY), NPAT EGP 63.1bn (+2% YoY headline / +18% normalized ex-Q325 EGP 13.1bn provision release), NPL 1.47% (343% coverage), CET1 25.3%, Total CAR 28.8%. Guided FY26 deposit growth ~30%.

debt_maturities.source: Private/DFI USD Tier 2 facility; CIB primarily funded via deep EGP/FCY domestic CASA deposits (EGP 1.11tn+).

verdict.stance: Overweight / Fortress-Capitalized Egyptian Private Bank Leader (Fitch B)
verdict.summary: Egypt's flagship private-sector bank delivered +18% normalized 9M26 profit growth (EGP 63.1bn on EGP 103bn revenue; NII +19% YoY) alongside exceptional solvency (28.8% CAR, 25.3% CET1) and ultra-clean 1.47% NPLs with 343% coverage. Rating is strictly sovereign-capped at Fitch 'B' Stable due to Egyptian T-bill/sovereign holdings.

positives: Extraordinary capital fortress: Sep-26 CET1 25.3% and Total CAR 28.8% (vs 27.3% FY25).
Elite asset quality & coverage: 9M26 NPLs down to 1.47% with massive 343% loan-loss coverage.
Superior deposit franchise (~30% FY26 deposit growth guidance, high CASA) driving +19% YoY NII even as CBE cuts rates.
negatives: Heavy balance sheet exposure to Egyptian sovereign debt caps Fitch IDR & VR at 'B'/'b'.
EGP FX/inflation sensitivity and historical CBE reserve/FX liquidity cycles.
Limited public USD Eurobond float (relies on domestic funding & DFI Tier 2 lines).

background.business_overview: Egypt's largest private-sector bank (EGX: COMI / LSE GDR), dominant in corporate, SME, and affluent retail banking.
background.asset_perimeter: Egyptian core banking (EGP 1.44tn+ assets), digital banking initiatives (yomo), and CIB Kenya.
background.ownership_governance: Institutional free float + ADQ (~18.6% stake); best-in-class Egyptian corporate governance.

recent_drivers: 9M26 (EGX): Revenue EGP 103bn (NII +19% YoY), NPAT EGP 63.1bn (+18% normalized YoY), NPL 1.47% (343% cov), CET1 25.3%, CAR 28.8%; lifted FY26 deposit growth guidance to ~30%.
